items.title: Derivation of Second Equation of Motion by Graphical Method (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Derivation of Second Equation of Motion by Graphical Method: a main subheading of 2.4 Equations of motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 28-28.

blocks.text: Velocity-time graph lein: body initial velocity vi se chal kar time t mein vf tak pohanchti hai, constant acceleration a ke saath, aur is dauran displacement S tay karti hai.

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi line AB velocity axis ke point A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Dashed lines E se B, A se C (length t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath double arrow vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Graph se dikhta hai ke tay kiya distance S = v × t hai, yani graph ke neeche ka area:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ke neeche ka area OABD tay kiya hua distance S hai. Ise do parts mein dekhein: neeche rectangle OACD, jis ka area OA × OD = vi × t hai, aur us ke oopar triangle ABC, jis ka area ½ × AC × BC = ½ × t × at hai. Dono ko add karne se S = vit + ½at² milta hai.

blocks.text_alt: Also S = Area of the figure OABD

blocks.latex: S = (\text{Area of the rectangle OACD}) + (\text{Area of the triangle ABC})
blocks.text_alt: S = (Area of the rectangle OACD) + (Area of the triangle ABC)
